worldcombat.skill.gust.summary: Whipping its wings, the user launches a short compressed puff of wind: a hit shoves the target along the wind, and an airborne target is blown farther and lifted a little. It is cheap, quick to reuse and lightly homing; the shove choice pushes harder for less power, the cut choice hits harder and shoves less.
worldcombat.skill.gust.use.0: Cheap, fast ranged chip you can throw again and again
worldcombat.skill.gust.use.1: Push a target off cover, off a ledge or away from an ally
worldcombat.skill.gust.use.2: Blow an airborne target farther away
worldcombat.skill.gust.description.0: Deals %1$s special damage to a living target, with a %2$s block puff radius.
worldcombat.skill.gust.description.1: The puff flies at %1$s blocks/tick and lightly homes on the target, reaching %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.gust.description.2: A hit shoves the target %1$s blocks away from the user; an airborne target is pushed x1.8 and lifted. The puff carries %2$s gusts of air.
worldcombat.skill.gust.shove.on: Shove: push distance x1.4 and a slightly tighter puff, built for moving people; costs power x0.85 and wind-up +1 tick.
worldcombat.skill.gust.shove.off: Cut: power x1.15 and a faster cast; costs push distance x0.7, making it more of a cheap ranged chip.
worldcombat.skill.gust.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.gust.growth.0: From level %1$s the puff power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.gust.growth.1: From level %1$s the puff power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
On: push distance x1.4 and a slightly tighter puff, built for moving people, at the cost of power x0.85 and wind-up +1 tick. Off (cut): power x1.15 and a faster cast, at the cost of push distance x0.7.
worldcombat.skill.gust.preference.ai.max: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.gust.preference.ai.fly: On: airborne targets rank higher (gust blows them farther away); off: all targets score the same.
